study: Gold 23:00 London intraday bias full research pipeline
authorization: User requested full pipeline to test whether gold can be improved; research only, no deployment
control: Same long/time exit/fixed volume; UTC half-hour chosen by deterministic day hash seed 290929. Skip entry/exit windows crossing 17:00 NY; no hindsight bar-completeness filter.
holdout_caveat: Recent holdout was already observed in discovery. Older holdout is new to this strategy, not guaranteed unused by other workspace research; reverse-time replication is not prospective validation.

search.procedure: One factor at a time, keep top three; no expansion after outcomes; stage 5 only if raw native gate passes
search.risk: 1% initial-stop target, rounded UP; divided across allowed simultaneous positions, cash overshoot disclosed; reduced 0.5% and adaptive sizing separate overlays, not edge optimization
search.exclusions: No news filter without complete point-in-time history. No asset transfer: user requested gold only. H4/D1 are completed-bar feature clocks, not a new longer-horizon strategy. No unconstrained weekend hold: scope is intraday bias. Next-level and partial exits must have explicit causal geometry and pass native parity before use.

selection: Development PF >=1.15, >=100 trades, positive P&L; rank (PF-1)*sqrt(n)/(1+equityDD/10). Neighbour plateau positive in >=75% of valid cells; validation chooses one, no holdout replacement.

stress.extra_cost: Measured native fill slippage/spread; missing cost data blocks live-ready claim

promotion: Stages 7-9 not authorized. Every failed gate stops advancement; no risk increase to manufacture improvement.
